newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines 91-day T-bill rate up at 13.572 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines 91-day T-bill rate up at 13.572 pct.

text.p: The 91-day Treasury bill rate was 13.572 percent, up from last week's 13.174 percent, at Monday's weekly Bureau of Treasury auction.
The 182-day rate was also higher at 13.967 percent from 13.756 percent.
The 364-day T-bill rate was 14.416 percent versus 13.106 percent.
For the 91-day bills the Treasury accepted 500 million pesos out of a total 1.05 billion tendered. For 182-day bills it also accepted 500 million pesos out of a total of 1.22 billion.
Of the 2.015 billion pesos tendered for 364-day bills, the Treasury accepted 670 million.
